forbidden_patterns.reason: OWASP A03: dangerouslySetInnerHTML bypasses React's XSS protection and can inject malicious scripts.
forbidden_patterns.remediation: Avoid dangerouslySetInnerHTML with user-controlled content. If HTML rendering is required, sanitize with DOMPurify.sanitize() before passing to __html.

forbidden_patterns.reason: OWASP A03: eval() enables arbitrary code execution and must never be used in React components.
forbidden_patterns.remediation: Remove eval(). Use JSON.parse() for JSON data. Refactor dynamic logic into explicit component state.

forbidden_patterns.reason: OWASP A03: The Function constructor is equivalent to eval() and allows arbitrary code execution.
forbidden_patterns.remediation: Refactor to use named or arrow functions rather than the dynamic Function constructor.

forbidden_patterns.reason: OWASP A02 / CIS Benchmark: Storing authentication tokens in localStorage exposes them to XSS attacks that can steal credentials.
forbidden_patterns.remediation: Store authentication tokens in HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite=Strict cookies via server-side session management.

forbidden_patterns.reason: OWASP A02: sessionStorage is accessible to all scripts on the page and vulnerable to XSS-based credential theft.
forbidden_patterns.remediation: Use server-side session management with HttpOnly, Secure cookies.

forbidden_patterns.reason: FIPS 140-3 / NIST SP 800-90A: Math.random() is not cryptographically secure and must not generate tokens or keys.
forbidden_patterns.remediation: Use crypto.getRandomValues() or crypto.randomUUID() from the Web Crypto API.

forbidden_patterns.reason: OWASP A01 / CWE-601: Open redirect vulnerability when redirect target is derived from user input.
forbidden_patterns.remediation: Validate redirect URLs against a whitelist of allowed destinations before assigning to window.location.href.

forbidden_patterns.reason: OWASP A03: document.write() with dynamic content is a classic XSS vector.
forbidden_patterns.remediation: Remove document.write(). Use React state and JSX to update DOM content.

forbidden_patterns.reason: OWASP A07 / NIST IA-5: Hardcoded password detected in source code.
forbidden_patterns.remediation: Remove hardcoded passwords. Load from environment variables or a secrets manager at runtime.

forbidden_patterns.reason: OWASP A03: JavaScript pseudo-protocol in href attributes enables XSS attacks.
forbidden_patterns.remediation: Never use javascript: in href. Validate that all URLs start with https:// or are relative paths.

forbidden_patterns.reason: OWASP A03 / DISA STIG: Assigning to .innerHTML with unsanitized data bypasses React's built-in XSS protection and can inject malicious scripts.
forbidden_patterns.remediation: Use element.textContent for plain text, or sanitize with DOMPurify.sanitize() before assigning to innerHTML. Prefer React-controlled rendering via JSX and component state.

forbidden_patterns.reason: OWASP A05 / CIS Level 2: Missing rel="noopener noreferrer" (both values required) on target="_blank" links exposes window.opener and enables tabnapping attacks.
forbidden_patterns.remediation: Add rel="noopener noreferrer" to every element that uses target="_blank".

forbidden_patterns.reason: OWASP A07 / NIST IA-5: Hardcoded API key or authentication token detected in source code. Secrets committed to source control are exposed in repositories and build artifacts.
forbidden_patterns.remediation: Remove all hardcoded credentials. Load API keys and tokens from environment variables (process.env.REACT_APP_API_KEY) or a secrets manager at runtime.

forbidden_patterns.reason: CVE-2025-55182 / OWASP A03: React 19 Server Actions must validate all inputs using schema validation. This pattern flags every 'use server' directive for mandatory review — each flagged function must be inspected to confirm that Zod or Yup schema validation is present before any formData input is used in a server-side operation.
forbidden_patterns.remediation: Validate all Server Action inputs using Zod or Yup schema validation before use. Ensure every 'use server' function validates its formData inputs before passing them to server-side operations. If validation is already present, this finding can be marked as reviewed.

forbidden_patterns.reason: OWASP A02 / CIS Level 2: Redux DevTools enabled unconditionally in production exposes the full application state tree, including potentially sensitive data, to browser extensions and developer tools.
forbidden_patterns.remediation: Guard the flag with an environment check: devTools: process.env.NODE_ENV !== 'production'.
